description: Schema for cleaned TLDraw shape data used in meeting recorder history.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shape, must always start with 'shape:'

x.description: The x-coordinate position of the shape on the canvas

y.description: The y-coordinate position of the shape on the canvas

rotation.description: The rotation angle of the shape in radians

opacity.description: The opacity of the shape, from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque)

props.description: Shape-specific properties that vary by shape type

color.description: The color of the shape (used in basic shapes and notes)

richText.description: Rich text content for shapes that contain text (notes, text, and geo shapes). For writes, you may set this using toRichText(...). For reads, this is the canonical text field.

text.description: Plain text content for shape writes (notes, text, and geo shapes). This will be converted to richText automatically by helpers, but may not be present when reading shapes.

url.description: URL associated with the shape (for images or links)

assetId.description: Reference to an asset in the TLDraw asset store (for images)

client.description: Client identifier for video and screen stream shapes

userName.description: User name associated with video and screen stream shapes

sourceFragmentId.description: The ID of the code fragment that is the source for this widget shape. Never set this manually.
